title: Lathe Master Unified Roadmap
brief: Unified lathe roadmap consolidating 9 prior envelopes into one 7-phase, 62-unit master plan targeting 5 concrete PRISM app features (Speed/Feed Calculator, Post-Processor Generator, Master Post-Processor, Print-to-Program, ERP/Business) on a shared AGI substrate (deep learning, deep reasoning, deep logic, neural networking, near-AGI intelligence).

phases.title: Audit + Harden
phases.goal: Inventory current state, verify wiring, identify gaps before building features.

units.title: Lathe Engine Inventory Reconciliation
units.description: Parse all 87 Lathe*.ts engines -> build lathe-engine-registry.json with {name, shortcode, LOC, exports, categories, test_coverage}.
units.rollback: git rm registry if count deviates

units.title: Dispatcher Wiring Audit for Lathe Actions
units.description: Scan camDispatcher and lathe*Dispatcher for lathe engine references; produce lathe-wiring-audit.md.
exit_conditions: 100% engines wired or flagged orphan with reason

units.title: Lathe Test Coverage Sweep
units.description: Run vitest filtered on Lathe*.test.ts; identify engines without test files; produce lathe-test-gap.md.
exit_conditions: Every engine has passing tests (>=10) or scheduled unit to add them

units.title: Physics Constants Inline-Usage Sweep (Lathe)
units.description: Grep lathe engines for inlined kc1.1, Taylor C/n, density, specific heat; refactor to import from constants.ts; build_verify.
exit_conditions: Zero inline physics constants in Lathe*.ts
units.rollback: git reset per-engine on test regress

units.title: Knowledge Source Completeness Check
units.description: For each P1-P5 feature, verify >=1 tribal tip file + >=1 reference program set + >=1 formula group exists.

units.title: Legacy Envelope Archival
units.description: Mark LATHE-PRO-MS0, LATHE-PRO-v2, LATHE-PRO-v3, LATHE-ROADMAP, LATHE-AI as status: archived, superseded_by: LATHE-MASTER; update roadmap-index.json; move legacy .md files to plans-archive/lathe-pre-consolidation/.

phases.title: Speed & Feed Calculator
phases.goal: Unified, AI-backed speed/feed calculator for PRISM web app + MCP action.

units.title: LatheSpeedFeedCalculatorFacadeEngine
units.description: Single facade consolidating 16 speed/feed engines behind .calculate({material, tool, op, machine}) -> AtomicValue<recommendation, band, confidence, sources[], reasoning[]>.

units.title: LatheSpeedFeedDeepLearningAdvisorEngine
units.description: Neural-net-backed advisor. Uses LatheDeepLearningIntelligenceEngine + LatheAttentionMechanismEngine. Returns DL-adjusted recommendation with top-3 feature SHAP scores.

units.title: LatheSpeedFeedReasoningBridgeEngine
units.description: Causal / counterfactual layer via LatheCausalInferenceEngine + LatheDeepReasoningEngine. Answers what-if scenarios.

units.title: Dispatcher Wiring for Speed/Feed Calculator
units.description: Wire lathe_sf_calculate, lathe_sf_advise, lathe_sf_whatif, lathe_sf_cite_sources, lathe_sf_explain through camDispatcher.

units.title: Web Calculator Panel (React)
units.description: web/src/pages/LatheSpeedFeedCalculator.tsx panel with form, result card, bands, explain, whatif.

units.title: Shop-Aware Tuning Layer
units.description: LatheSpeedFeedShopAwareTuningEngine adjusts by JM Die actuals via LatheActualFeedbackTuningEngine + LatheShopAwareOptimizationEngine.
exit_conditions: JM Die profile produces >5% delta vs generic

units.title: Speed/Feed Calculator Regression Suite
units.description: Golden dataset of 200 {material, tool, op} cases with expected Vc/fn ranges from Sandvik/Kennametal catalogs.

units.title: Forge-Triple for Speed/Feed Calculator
units.description: Hook speed-feed-out-of-band-guard + action prism_lathe:sf_full + skill /auto-speed-feed-lathe.

phases.exit_gate: Machinist opens calculator, enters real JM Die job, gets recommendation within +/- 5% of Sandvik catalog, sees DL confidence band, asks what-if, result cited.

phases.title: Post-Processor Generator
phases.goal: Given {controller vendor, machine kinematics, axis map, dialect quirks}, automatically generate a new post-processor artifact with full validator stack and regression tests.

units.title: Controller Spec Ingestion Engine
units.description: LathePostGeneratorSpecIngestEngine accepts controller manual PDF/spec -> normalized ControllerSpec. Uses PPControllerEmbeddingEngine.
exit_conditions: Ingests Fanuc 31i-T, Okuma OSP-P300L, Mitsubishi M80

units.title: Post-Processor Skeleton Generator
units.description: LathePostGeneratorSkeletonEngine emits NewLathePost.ts skeleton with all required hooks, pre-wired against all PP* validators.

units.title: Dialect Transfer Learning
units.description: LathePostDialectTransferEngine transfers G-code patterns from known-good post to novel dialect with minimal examples.
exit_conditions: 5 Okuma + 1 Mitsubishi -> viable Mitsubishi post passes 80%+ validators

units.title: Validator Stack Auto-Wiring for Generated Posts
units.description: LathePostGeneratorValidatorWiringEngine auto-wires all 27 PP* validators with per-validator config from ControllerSpec.
exit_conditions: All 27 validators run on reference program without hard-fail on valid programs

units.title: Regression Test Auto-Generator
units.description: LathePostGeneratorTestSynthEngine generates vitest test file with fixtures from matching reference programs in JM Die archive.
exit_conditions: New post emits test file with >=20 fixtures

units.title: Knowledge-Graph Integration
units.description: LathePostGeneratorKnowledgeIndexEngine registers each generated post into PPKnowledgeIndexEngine + ManufacturingKnowledgeGraphEngine.
exit_conditions: Generated post appears in knowledge graph

units.title: Active-Learning Feedback Loop
units.description: LathePostGeneratorActiveLearningEngine queues shop-floor failures into PPActiveLearningQueueEngine; regeneration incorporates corrections.
exit_conditions: Simulated failure -> queue -> regen produces corrected post verified against fixture

units.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Generated Posts
units.description: LathePostGeneratorUncertaintyEngine uses PPEnsembleUncertaintyEngine for per-block confidence. Blocks ship if ensemble disagreement > 15%.

units.title: Dispatcher Wiring for Generator
units.description: Wire lathe_postgen_{ingest, skeleton, transfer, validate, test, register, feedback, uncertainty} through camDispatcher.

units.title: Forge-Triple for Post-Processor Generator
units.description: Hook postgen-validator-skip-guard + action prism_lathe:postgen_full + skill /lathe-postgen.
exit_conditions: End-to-end test produces working Mitsubishi post

phases.exit_gate: Given Mitsubishi M80 spec + 3 reference programs, generator produces a Mitsubishi lathe post that (a) compiles, (b) passes all 27 validators, (c) round-trips reference program within 95% fidelity, (d) registers into knowledge graph, (e) exposes uncertainty per-block.

phases.title: Master Post-Processor
phases.goal: Single canonical post in PRISM app routing to correct per-machine post for any JM Die machine. Self-aware, self-updating.

units.title: LatheMasterPostRouterEngine
units.description: Central router: given {machineId, operation, controller} -> selects and invokes correct sub-post. Integrates with ShopConfigurationEngine.
exit_conditions: Routes to correct sub-post for all 21 JM Die machines
Fallback via P2 generator for unknown

units.title: LatheMasterPostUnifiedOutputEngine
units.description: Unifies output format across sub-posts. Standard header/footer/metadata via PPModalStateTrackerEngine.
exit_conditions: Diff between any 2 sub-posts shows only legitimate dialect differences

units.title: LatheMasterPostSelfAwarenessEngine
units.description: Continuously audits sub-posts via PostProcessorAGIContinuousLearningEngine + PostProcessorAISelfAwarenessIntegrationEngine. Detects drift, flags regeneration.
exit_conditions: Seeded drift detection produces remediation recommendation

units.title: LatheMasterPostDeepReasoningEngine
units.description: Uses LatheDeepReasoningEngine + CausalReasoningEngine to explain WHY master post picked a sub-post.
exit_conditions: Human-readable decision trace with >=4 reasoning steps

units.title: LatheMasterPostEnsembleCrossCheckEngine
units.description: When two sub-posts could serve a job, runs both, compares outputs, flags divergence > 10% block-count or > 5% cycle-time.

units.title: LatheMasterPostAPIEngine + Dispatcher Wiring
units.description: Wire lathe_masterpost_{route, emit, validate, explain, cross_check, audit} through camDispatcher; REST in routes/python-api.ts.
exit_conditions: Web UI POSTs job -> master post -> G-code + explanation

units.title: Master Post Regression Test Matrix
units.description: Golden matrix of 150 jobs across 21 JM Die machines + 5 validator groups.

units.title: Forge-Triple for Master Post
units.description: Hook masterpost-unknown-machine-guard + action prism_lathe:masterpost_full + skill /lathe-masterpost.

phases.exit_gate: Selecting any JM Die lathe in PRISM app -> Master Post emits validated G-code + explanation trace within 3 seconds. Unknown machines auto-trigger P2 generator path.

phases.title: Print-to-Program (THE BIG ONE)
phases.goal: End-to-end blueprint -> G-code pipeline: PDF drop -> OCR -> feature recognition -> GD&T -> strategy -> toolpath -> master post emission -> validation -> signoff dossier.

units.title: Blueprint Ingest + Vision-OCR Pipeline
units.description: LathePrintIngestPipelineEngine orchestrates BlueprintVisionOCR + PDFBlueprintDimensionExtractor + GDTCalloutParser -> BlueprintIntake JSON.
exit_conditions: 10 JM Die drawings round-tripped with >=90% dim-extraction accuracy

units.title: Turning Feature Recognition
units.description: LatheTurningFeatureRecognizerEngine emits turning feature list {OD, ID, face, groove, thread, chamfer, radius}.
exit_conditions: >=12 feature types on 20 JM Die parts

units.title: GD&T Tolerance Propagation
units.description: LathePrintToleranceStackEngine propagates GDT through feature->operation chain; assigns per-feature Cpk target.
exit_conditions: Stack-up warnings when chain exceeds budget

units.title: Feature-to-Strategy Mapping (CAMX-MS12 handoff)
units.description: LathePrintFeatureStrategySelectorEngine consumes features + tolerance + material + machine. Delegates to FeatureStrategyKnowledgeBaseEngine (CAMX-MS12 E1112, 203 rules).
exit_conditions: Strategies cited with KB rule IDs

units.title: Multi-Op Sequence Planning
units.description: LathePrintSequencePlannerEngine from strategy plan -> ordered sequence with stock state tracking. Uses StrategySequencingEngine (CAMX-MS12 U06).
exit_conditions: Valid sequence for all 20 test parts

units.title: Workholding + Setup Selection
units.description: LathePrintSetupSelectionEngine selects chuck jaws, tailstock engagement, steady rest. Uses FixtureAwareStrategyEngine (CAMX-MS12 U07).

units.title: Toolpath Generation + CAM Integration
units.description: LathePrintToolpathGeneratorEngine from operation sequence -> per-op toolpath via LatheCAMIntelligenceEngine + P1 speed/feed.
exit_conditions: Cycle time within 10% of Mastercam ground truth

units.title: Program Emission via Master Post
units.description: LathePrintProgramEmitterEngine sends toolpath through Master Post (P3) -> G-code + signoff dossier.

units.title: Program Validation + Signoff Dossier
units.description: LathePrintProgramSignoffEngine runs all 27 PP* validators + physics + safety. Produces machinist-grade signoff PDF.

units.title: Print-to-Program Deep-Learning Intelligence
units.description: LathePrintToProgramDLIntelligenceEngine predicts failure probability and suggests corrections via LatheDeepLearningIntelligenceEngine + LatheAttentionMechanismEngine.
exit_conditions: Failure prediction >=75% accuracy on 50-program held-out set

units.title: Print-to-Program Reasoning Layer
units.description: LathePrintToProgramReasoningEngine explains full decision chain via LatheDeepReasoningEngine + LatheOpusReasoningEngine + CausalReasoningEngine + CounterfactualReasoningEngine.
exit_conditions: >=10 decision steps in reasoning trace per fixture

units.title: Print-to-Program Knowledge Graph Integration
units.description: LathePrintToProgramKnowledgeGraphEngine adds nodes/edges to ManufacturingKnowledgeGraph per emission.
exit_conditions: Graph queries return semantically relevant matches

units.title: Print-to-Program Dispatcher Wiring + Web UI
units.description: Wire lathe_p2p_{ingest, features, tolerance, strategy, sequence, setup, toolpath, emit, signoff, explain, kg_query} through camDispatcher + web/src/pages/LathePrintToProgram.tsx.

units.title: Print-to-Program End-to-End Regression
units.description: Golden matrix of 50 JM Die prints -> 50 programs -> diff against machinist-approved baseline.

units.title: Forge-Triple for Print-to-Program
units.description: Hook p2p-cpk-below-gate (uses CpkPredictionGateEngine E1203) + action prism_lathe:p2p_full + skill /lathe-print-to-program.
exit_conditions: Full pipeline runs on 10 fresh JM Die prints E2E

phases.exit_gate: Drop a PDF blueprint -> 60 seconds later you have a validated G-code program with signoff dossier (toolpath viz, Cpk predictions, reasoning trace, risk summary). Machinist accepts >=8/10 without material corrections.

phases.title: ERP / Business Management
phases.goal: Shop-grade business layer: quotes, actual costs, scheduling, customers, inventory, POs, invoicing. Feeds off P1/P3/P4 outputs.

units.title: LatheAutoQuoteFromPrintEngine
units.description: Bridge P4 print-to-program output -> instant quote. BlueprintToQuoteBridgeEngine + QuoteEstimatorEngine + LathePartCostModelEngine.
exit_conditions: <=10% variance vs manual on 10 JM Die fixtures

units.title: LatheActualCostReconciliationEngine
units.description: Reconciles actual vs quoted cost; feeds LatheActualFeedbackTuningEngine for next quote.

units.title: LatheJobSchedulingEngine
units.description: Integrates quotes -> shop schedule. ShopSchedulerEngine + JobShopSchedulingEngine + ShiftScheduleOptimizerEngine.

units.title: LatheCustomerOrderLifecycleEngine
units.description: Tracks customer -> order -> quote -> job -> shipment -> invoice lifecycle.
exit_conditions: End-to-end lifecycle visible in web UI

units.title: LathePurchaseOrderAutomationEngine
units.description: Auto-generates PO requirements (stock, tools, consumables) on quote. PurchaseOrderEngine + InventoryAwareToolSelectorEngine + InventoryEOQEngine.

units.title: LatheInventoryIntelligenceEngine
units.description: Real-time inventory view with EOQ + reorder triggers. InventoryOptimizationEngine + InventoryEOQEngine + JMDieProgramInventoryEngine.
exit_conditions: Reorder alerts fire on seeded data

units.title: LatheJobProfitabilityAnalyticsEngine
units.description: Per-job profitability waterfall. JobProfitabilityWaterfallEngine + CustomerPortfolioMinerEngine.

units.title: LatheBusinessIntelligenceDashboard
units.description: Web dashboard consolidating quotes, jobs, schedule, inventory, profitability, KPIs. web/src/pages/LatheERPDashboard.tsx.

units.title: Dispatcher Wiring for ERP
units.description: Wire lathe_erp_{quote_from_print, reconcile, schedule, lifecycle, po, inventory, profitability, dashboard} through businessDispatcher.

units.title: Forge-Triple for ERP
units.description: Hook erp-quote-variance-guard + action prism_lathe:erp_full + skill /lathe-erp and /quote-to-ship-lathe.
exit_conditions: E2E JM Die order flows quote -> schedule -> po -> invoice

phases.exit_gate: A JM Die salesperson uploads a PDF -> gets quote in <2 minutes with <=10% variance. The job lifecycles through schedule -> PO -> machine -> reconcile -> invoice, all visible on ERP dashboard.

phases.title: AGI Deep-Learning Cross-Cutting
phases.goal: Ensure AGI substrate actually runs through P1-P5, not just isolated engines. Cross-cutting units unifying DL/NN/reasoning across features.

units.title: LatheAGIFeatureBridgeEngine
units.description: Central bridge: .reason(featureName, context) -> {prediction, explanation, confidence, novel_insights[]} for P1-P5.

units.title: LatheAGIContinuousLearningEngine
units.description: Long-running learner consuming P1/P4/P5 outcomes. LatheActiveLearningEngine + LatheMetaLearningEngine + JobLearningEngine.
exit_conditions: Seeded rejection -> next prediction shows behavior change

units.title: LatheAGIKnowledgeUnificationEngine
units.description: Unifies LatheKnowledgeGraphEngine + ManufacturingKnowledgeGraphEngine + KnowledgeGraphNeuralBridgeEngine.
exit_conditions: Single query endpoint returns nodes+edges from 3 sub-graphs

units.title: LatheAGISafetyContainmentEngine (integration)
units.description: Integrate AGISafetyContainmentEngine to bound outputs: no unsafe speeds, no absurd quotes, no out-of-capacity schedules. Uses FuzzyNeuralHybridEngine.
exit_conditions: Adversarial inputs caught + rejected with safety trace

units.title: Forge-Triple for AGI Substrate
units.description: Hook agi-safety-envelope-guard + action prism_lathe:agi_reason + skill /lathe-agi-explain.
exit_conditions: All 3 deliverables tested against all 5 features

phases.exit_gate: Any P1-P5 output produces AGI reasoning trace with >=5 steps, confidence bands, novel-insight flags. Safety bounds hard-enforced.

critical_path: U-LTH01 -> U-LTH06 -> U-LTH14 -> U-LTH24 -> U-LTH32 -> U-LTH47 -> U-LTH57 -> U-LTH62 (~22 sessions)
whole_roadmap_exit_gates: Machinist: Controller spec PDF -> working post <5min [P2]
Machinist: Any JM Die machine -> master post G-code <3s [P3]
Machinist: Customer print PDF -> signoff dossier + G-code <60s accepted 8/10 [P4]
Salesperson: Same PDF -> Quote + schedule + PO + inventory <90s [P5]
Every output: AGI reasoning trace >=5 steps, confidence, sources, novel insights [PX]
